rationale: Browser capability probe diagnostics only: the browser-capability-unavailable message now leads with the probe's own failure reason, a timed-out probe reports its deadline, and PULP_DESIGN_BROWSER_PROBE_TIMEOUT_MS can raise the probe deadline. Capture, Chromium launch flags, DesignIR lowering, rendering and packaging are unchanged; no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
